d: Pale lime-green hair is styled in a high ponytail with long, flowing strands and sweeping bangs. The eyes are a matching pale lime-green with a narrow, calculating expression, set upon a face with the maturity of a young adult. The build is slender, dressed in a dark brown high-collared garment accented by gold trim and a forest green sash featuring a gold-rimmed green gemstone. Gold-rimmed glasses and gold cuffs on the wrists serve as the primary accessories.
